beats.summary: Michael distributes leads to various employees but replaces them with clues for a scavenger hunt.

evidence.snippet: Michael: Hello. May I have everyone's attention, please? Gabe has instructed me to hand out the leads, so I'm going to give the leads to… King Creed!
Michael: Oh, right, those are clues. And within each clue is a lesson. You learn a lesson, and then you find a lead.

beats.summary: Angela makes Phyllis do excessive clerical work before giving her the leads.

evidence.snippet: Angela: I'll give you the leads. But you know what? It's going to cost you some clerical work
Angela: It doesn't matter. Fill them out. All of them. Then when you're done, you can watch me shred them.

beats.summary: Andy tries to find leads hidden by Erin through a series of clues.

evidence.snippet: Andy: Hey. I guess you probably won't give me your leads since I'm a jerk salesman.
Erin (mimes zipping mouth and throwing away key, Andy begins to walk away): Colder. Colder. Warmer. Warmer. Colder. Colder. Warmer. Warmer. Warmer. Hot. Hotter. Pretty hot. Lower.

beats.summary: Dwight attempts to find leads and interrogates Kevin, who misleads him about their location.

evidence.snippet: Dwight: Michael? Michael, you were supposed to tell me when the leads came in.
Kevin: Turn the trash. Turn the trash.

beats.summary: Michael and Dwight search the city dump for the lost leads after they were thrown away.

evidence.snippet: Dwight (dives into dumpster, rattling noises then he emerges): It's empty!

notable_quotes.quote: I am trying to make your kids respect you. Because a father needs to respect his boss, and kids don't respect the father who doesn't respect the boss.
notable_quotes.speaker: Michael

notable_quotes.quote: If you want to find your leads, go to the man who never breathes.
notable_quotes.speaker: Michael

evidence.snippet: Michael: Well, bigshot, 'If you want to find your leads, go to the man who never breathes'.

notable_quotes.quote: The prankster is getting pranked. Ha ha.
notable_quotes.speaker: Dwight

evidence.snippet: Dwight: The prankster is getting pranked. Ha ha.
Michael: Okay, no, you encouraged it. You were complicit Complicit. You were all successories!
